sentences.text: Emily Jane Browning -LRB- born 7 December 1988 -RRB- is an Australian actress and singer .

Browning made her film debut in the Australian television film The Echo of Thunder , subsequently , she played recurring roles in the Australian television shows Blue Heelers and Something in the Air .	The Echo of Thunder	The Echo of Thunder	Blue Heelers	Blue Heelers	Something in the Air	Something in the Air (TV series)
